They are singing, with their eyes directed forward and mouths moving in a synchronized, rhythmic fashion. (2) The camera cuts to another trio: a person with long curly hair in a black hoodie, a woman in a bright pink jacket, and a man in a yellow plaid shirt. They are also singing, maintaining steady postures and neutral to emotive facial expressions. (3) A group of three girls is shown again; one holds a long microphone boom with a yellow Yes sticker. They are positioned in front of a glass door reflecting indoor lights. Their focus remains entirely on the vocal performance. (4) The scene transitions between different members of the singing group. The camera focuses on a man wearing a black beanie and black hoodie who is laughing while wiping tears from his eyes with a folded cardboard sheet, showing high emotional impact.
